findings.desc: Lock path inconsistency between two adopted truth sources: story-lifecycle.md (line 120) specifies `.koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock` for DONE serialization (already implemented in done-effects.ts), while the new session-ownership-and-write-leases.md proposes `.koala/locks/main-write.lock/` as the preferred main write lock storage path. An implementer following both adopted docs for the write-lease implementation story will encounter contradictory storage paths for what is logically the same DONE-serialization primitive.
